text:
Priya (People Ops): Hey team — drafted a short manager welcome script + operational asks for new managers (first 72h, week 1, and a 30/60/90 skeleton). Trying to make it copy-pasteable for hiring managers. Pls quick review and add any must-have "who to ask" lines.

Priya (People Ops): DRAFT below — keep it terse for Slack/Notion: 

---
Manager Welcome Script (copyable)

Hi {{newhire}}, welcome to Redwood! I’m {{manager}} — excited to have you on the team. Quick ops to get you productive:

Day 0 (preboard)
- Confirm Okta invite + set MFA (IT)
- Grant Console read access + repo access request (DevEx)
- Slack intro + calendar invites for 1:1, team sync, and kickoff

Day 1 (first 8 hrs)
- 09:00 — Quick intro + expectations (15m)
- 09:20 — Setup check (accounts, VPN, KMS access) (20m)
- 10:00 — Product walkthrough & immediate priorities (30m)
- 11:00 — Pair on dev environment + first small task (90m)
- End of day — 1:1 recap, confirm any blocked access

Week 1 deliverables
- Complete access checklist, get green in Console for target services
- Ship first small commit / doc update with manager pairing
- 1:1 every other day to align ramp questions

30/60/90 for managers to discuss with new hire (high level)
- 30d: onboarding complete, first independent task, feedback check
- 60d: owning a small project, cross-team syncs established
- 90d: measurable impact (feature/ops/quality) + performance/goals conversation

Who to ask (quick map)
- IT: MFA, laptop imaging, VPN — @Sam
- DevEx: repo access, CI tokens — @Marta or devexbot
- Security/Compliance: KMS/HSM requests — @Jordan (sec)
- Payroll/Benefits: benefits enrollment, probation timeline — @Jordan (HR)

Ops asks for managers (short)
- Create calendar blocks for 1:1 + onboarding coffee (15m)
- Assign onboarding buddy (someone on your team)
- Confirm access tickets within 24 hours, escalate if blocked

Notes: put this in Notion template and attach checklist link.
---

Avery (Eng Manager): Love the format. Can we add a short line under Day 1: "shadow on an oncall rotation overview (15m)"? Also suggest adding a sentence about how to raise infra tickets (who owns the queue).

Sam (IT): I'll make a one-click checklist for Okta/GSuite/Okta MFA/VPN/Laptop imaging and add the link. Also add the command for KMS ticket: `https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa` with label `access-onboard`.

Jordan (HR): Add benefits enrollment window (first 30 days) and probation review cadence (30/60). Also we usually schedule a welcome with People Ops in week 1 — pls include "People Ops intro (30m)".

Marta (People Ops): Added a DevEx contact line and swapped Security owner to @sec-team (we use that alias). Pushed an initial Notion template: https://notion.redwood.com/manager-onboard-template (will update with links).

Priya (People Ops): Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can someone volunteer to be the primary onboarding buddy list owner? 2) we should include a short "manager checklist to close" at day 7 (confirm access, first PR merged, feedback scheduled).

Avery (Eng Manager): I can own buddy pool for Eng for the next hires — I'll post a short rota tomorrow. :handshake:

onboard-bot: Reminder created for: "Populate manager onboarding template" due in 3 days.

Marta (People Ops): I'll add the day-7 close checklist and update the Notion template. Will ping when live.

Priya (People Ops): Perfect — when Notion is live can we add a small blurb managers can paste into the new hire Slack intro? Example: "Please welcome {{name}} joining as {{role}}. They'll be pairing with {{buddy}} this week. Qs?"

Avery (Eng Manager): Thumbs up. Thanks everyone!

Sam (IT): FYI I'll auto-create access tickets for any hires with `#onboard` tag in HR form. Link to form: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request

---

(End thread)
